parts.text: An applicant earns RM 4,500 gross per month and supports 3 dependants. Under the current underwriting policy, what is their minimum Net Disposable Income (NDI) floor, and which earlier policy version did it supersede?

Under Credit Underwriting Policy v2 (POL-CR-001-v2, Version 2.0, effective 2026-01-01, Clause 3.2), the mandatory post-drawdown Net Disposable Income (NDI) floor for an applicant supporting 3 or more dependants is RM 2,000 (compared to the RM 1,500 baseline for fewer than 3 dependants). This superseded Credit Underwriting Policy v1 (POL-CR-001-v1, Version 1.0, effective 2025-01-01, Clause 3.2), which applied a flat RM 1,500 NDI floor regardless of dependant count.
What is the maximum late-payment charge on an AEON Classic Visa Card, and is there any discrepancy across our product documents?

Under the authoritative Schedule of Fees & Charges (FEE-001, effective 2026-03-01, Clause 4.0), the late-payment charge is 1% of the unpaid outstanding balance, subject to a minimum of RM 10 and a maximum cap of RM 100. Note the document conflict: the earlier AEON Classic Visa Product Disclosure Sheet (PDS-CARD-CLASSIC, effective 2025-06-01, Clause 6.0) still lists a stale RM 150 maximum cap, which has been superseded by FEE-001.
What is the annual fee and waiver condition for the AEON Platinum Visa Card under our latest schedule and 2026 promo circular?

According to the Schedule of Fees & Charges (FEE-001, effective 2026-03-01) and Circular CIR-03 (2026 Annual Fee Waiver Campaign Matrix, effective 2026-02-01), the AEON Platinum Visa Card annual fee is RM 388 p.a. for the Principal card and RM 188 p.a. for a Supplementary card, waived in the first year and waived in subsequent years with RM 18,000 minimum annual retail spend or 12 retail swipe transactions per anniversary year.
In the scanned Employment & Salary Verification Form (FORM-001), what is the verified gross monthly salary and the employee EPF statutory deduction amount?

According to the Employment & Salary Verification Form (FORM-001, effective 2026-01-01), the applicant's verified gross monthly salary is RM 4,200.00, and the employee EPF statutory deduction is RM 462.00 (11% statutory employee contribution rate).
Berapakah had maksimum DSR untuk pemohon bergaji RM 4,500 sebulan?

Berdasarkan Polisi Pengunderaitan Kredit v2 (POL-CR-001-v2, berkuat kuasa 2026-01-01) dan Soalan Lazim Kad Kredit (FAQ-CARD-MS, S7), had maksimum Nisbah Khidmat Hutang (DSR) bagi pemohon dengan pendapatan kasar RM 4,500 sebulan (RM 3,000 hingga RM 5,000) ialah 60%.
I am a retail customer using the public self-service portal. Using only public customer-facing documents, what happens if my Personal Financing-i monthly instalment is overdue by 10 days?

Based on our public Schedule of Fees & Charges (FEE-001) and Personal Financing-i Product Disclosure Sheet (PDS-PF-001), if your monthly instalment is overdue past the payment due date, a late payment compensation charge (Ta'widh) of 1% per annum on the overdue instalment amount applies, calculated daily from the due date until settlement.
